A '''Royal Guard''' variant were [[Soldier/Legends|troopers]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] that were visually identical to the [[Emperor's Royal Guard/Legends|Emperor's Royal Guard]], only with blue attire similar to that of [[Imperial Senate Guard/Legends|Imperial Senate Guards]]. At least one member of this group was stationed aboard the [[Death Star II/Legends|Death Star II]] during the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]].
